source: runner: ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-<start time>-<session id>.jsonl (find the file whose session_meta.payload.cwd is the worker worktree)
how_read: model = turn_context.payload.model; tokens = the LAST event_msg/token_count payload.info.total_token_usage (cumulative); context window = info.model_context_window; peak context = max over token_count events of info.last_token_usage.input_tokens; duration = last minus first line timestamp
no_cost_field: the record has tokens but no dollar cost; cost would be computed from a price table
